editions.label: from the workshop
editions.intro: Recent updates across our apps focus on better continuity and expanded integration for your workflows.

items.body: MyLLM now keeps MyLLMos apps running in a paused state so you can switch between them. Shell and Bin are included, and the assistant can now hear the actual results of actions it performs.
Project Manager now works with the free WorkFlow Companion on Windows or Linux. You can assign tasks to specific computers by using their names, such as @Server, within your comments.
E-Grid's weekly digest now includes detailed race reports, podium standings, and championship leads. Every round opens a dedicated race page with highlights, teams, and driver information.

principles.free: Every Opticell app is free to download. You can install our software and test it on your own device without providing any card details or committing to a purchase. This allows you to judge the utility of the tool before deciding to unlock its full features.
principles.upgrades: You can choose between an ultra-affordable subscription or a one-time lifetime unlock. Both options are entirely opt-in. Subscriptions can be managed or cancelled at any time through your Apple or Google account settings.
principles.pricing: We believe you should know the cost before you commit. Every price is clearly visible on the App Store and Google Play product pages before installation. We also show all costs within the app itself, with no hidden fees or fine print.
principles.privacy: Privacy is our default setting. We do not use analytics to track your usage, nor do we sell information to advertisers or data brokers. Your data stays on your device where it belongs.
principles.ads: Our apps contain no banners, interstitials, or sponsored content. Advertisements compete for your attention and create an incentive for apps to harvest user data. We avoid this model entirely to keep our software focused and clean.
principles.partnership: Where our apps use AI, the technology is designed to extend human capability rather than replace human judgement. The software acts as a tool to assist your workflow, ensuring that you always remain in control of the final outcome.
principles.audience: Our catalogue provides tools for both personal use and professional environments on the same terms. Whether you are using DrawPad for creative work or My Business Portal for organisation, you receive the same honest service.

editions.label: from the workshop
editions.intro: Our October 2026 updates introduce better tool management in MyLLM, expanded racing details in E-Grid, and new cross-platform connectivity for Project Manager.

items.body: Project Manager now works with the free WorkFlow Companion. You can use Claude on a Windows or Linux PC to manage tasks and notes via iCloud, using @mentions to assign work to specific computers.
MyLLM now manages MCP server tools more efficiently by loading them only when needed. You can also edit text files directly in the preview and see save receipts under your replies.
E-Grid's weekly digest now includes detailed race results, qualifying times, and championship standings. Every round opens a dedicated race page with reports, highlights, and team information.

editions.label: from the workshop
editions.intro: Recent updates to our apps focus on expanding device compatibility and improving interface design for iOS 26.

items.body: MyLLM now includes a room scanner for LiDAR-equipped iPhones. It creates floor plans with measured walls and furniture. The assistant can also edit your apps by running tests and fixing errors automatically.

IP Dashboard is now available on Mac, syncing via iCloud. The Agent Bridge allows AI assistants to read your portfolio and add notes or reminders. We have also corrected several trademark and patent schedules.
Hanyu has been updated for iOS 26 with a full-screen layout that extends under the Dynamic Island. The new floating glass tab bar and improved dark mode ensure all interface elements remain readable.

editions.label: from the workshop
editions.intro: Recent updates to our apps focus on improved system integration, refined interface designs, and faster performance.

items.body: MyLLM now supports MiniCPM5 2B and Gemma 4 E2B models. These allow for tool use like checking weather or reading photos on compatible iPhones. Bots can also react to file changes in a folder.
Hanyu features a new full-screen design for iOS 26 that extends under the Dynamic Island. The update includes a translucent floating tab bar and improved dark mode visibility for the status bar.
WalkFindr generates walks much faster and introduces community sharing. You can now share saved walks to the Community tab for others to find, with clearer error messages if a share fails.

groups.label: Open tools
groups.blurb: Things you can run, read or build on — not just look at.

items.name: myllm-connect
items.description: Run your own private AI backend on Mac/PC and connect MyLLM in one tap over trusted HTTPS (Tailscale). The free onramp to the paid iOS app.

items.name: myllm-skills
items.description: Curated open Agent-Skill format skills for MyLLM (the on-device iOS AI agent). Install with /skill add teamdzx/myllm-skills.

items.name: workflow-agent-bridge
items.description: Agent bridge + MCP server for the WorkFlow task manager: lets Claude Code read and write tasks, file hand-offs and keep a session log.

groups.label: Live app content
groups.blurb: Our apps fetch their catalogues from these, in the open. What you see here is what the app sees.

items.name: egrid-content
items.description: Catalogue and editorial content for the E-Grid motorsport companion app — channels, track guides, driver bios, team profiles and broadcast listings. Fetched at runtime so corrections ship without an App Store submission.

items.name: hanyu-packs
items.description: Free over-the-air content packs for the Hanyu iOS app — characters, compound words, sentences and bespoke lessons, shipped without an App Store submission.

items.name: dice-assets

items.name: linkfindr-assets
